The commissioning brief suggested this working lineage so later evidence has a place to land:

**institutional or agency care → disability-led independent-living experiments → Creekview → Enhanced Consumer Participation Model (ECPM) → direct individualized funding → CSIL design and pilot → a province-wide program.**

That sentence remains a **research proposition**. No page on this site treats Creekview → ECPM → CSIL as a proven formal succession. The chapters below reconstruct what public sources now support and label what they do not.

| Working date | Chapter | Status on this site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early 1980s | Independent-living / community-living advocacy in British Columbia | **Folded into Creekview.** [Origins](origins.qmd) records that choice. Context is Haw 1989’s later overview plus 1984–86 Hansard, not a separate origins narrative. |
| c. 1984–89 | [Creekview](creekview.qmd) | Cited chapter (Hansard 1984 and 1986; Haw 1989; 1987 abstract; later SCI BC / Fayerman accounts) |
| c. 1987 | Creekview evaluation | Evaluation attested; report copy not held; Ryan authorship unconfirmed |
| c. 1990 | [ECPM](ecpm.qmd) and *Keys on Freedom* | Cited ECPM reconstruction: 1990 manual bibliographically attested (unread); *Keys on Freedom* still unconfirmed |
| c. 1993 | CSIL “established” (later label) | Contested later recollection only; see [design/pilot](csil-pilot.qmd) |
| c. 1994 | CSIL pilot / later “established” | Later official: pilot / introduced. Later recollection also uses 1994. 1994 ECPM manual identity remains insufficient evidence. |
| c. 1995 | Wider / province-wide availability | Later official chronology (Ombudsperson 2012); contemporaneous HEU still says “new/pilot” |
| 2008–2012 | [Later evolution](evolution.qmd) | Cited sketch: 2008 review synthesis; 2011 rates; current CSG / representative definitions |

## State of the evidence

### Well established (from inspected or bibliographic public sources)

- Creekview existed as a mid-1980s community residence for a small group of men with high-level, mostly ventilator-dependent quadriplegia, planned by February 1984 and in place by April 1986 ([Creekview](creekview.qmd)).
- A 1990 ECPM *Skill Development Manual* (BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society; five modules) is independently cited in the Roeher / Salisbury bibliography. The manual itself has not been read ([ECPM](ecpm.qmd)).
- By late 1995 a Ministry of Health program publicly named Choice in Supports for Independent Living existed and was described as new/pilot, housed in Community Support Branch / Continuing Care Division ([HEU *Guardian* Nov/Dec 1995](../sources/1995-heu-guardian-novdec.qmd)).
- A November 2008 CSIL Program Review Synthesis Report exists and has been inspected as an Internet Archive Microlog fiche. It dates CSIL only to “the 1990's.”
- Current ministry policy defines CSIL employer, client support group, and CSIL representative ([HCC Policy 4.C](../sources/hcc-policy-manual-4c.qmd)). Those are present rules, not recovered 1990s instruments.

### Later reconstruction / attributed

- SCI BC and journalistic accounts of Creekview residents, championship language, and the “Creekside” spelling.
- IFRC and Gauthier decks that name ECPM as a pre-CSIL step and that call CSIL “established” in 1993 or 1994.
- Ombudsperson 2012’s pairing of **pilot 1994** and **province-wide 1995**, including later wording that the mid-1990s policy already contemplated a client support group.
- Order of Canada “Initiator” language for Paul Gauthier (official honour, not a 1990s file).

### Unresolved / missing

- Formal succession from Creekview to ECPM to CSIL.
- Full text of the 1990 ECPM manual; identity of any 1994 ECPM training manual (**INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE**).
- *Keys on Freedom* (title/author/year still commissioning-issue only).
- Original 1993–95 Ministry of Health design/pilot instruments.
- A single founding year. This archive uses **PARTIAL STAGED CHRONOLOGY**: later official meanings for 1994 and 1995, a conflicting later 1993 label, and contemporaneous late-1995 pilot language that does not confirm province-wide completion.
- 1987 Creekview evaluation report (attested; copy sought).
- Whether *Best of Care*’s “provincial review in 2007” is the 2008 synthesis.
